recalled_knowledge.item: XENON1T 2018 exposure 1.0 t yr (278.8 d x 1.3 t), ROI cS1 < 70 PE ~ 41 keV NR
LZ SR1: 60 live days x 5.5 t = 0.90 t yr, ROI S1c < 80 phd (~70 keV)
LUX complete exposure 3.35e4 kg d (0.092 t yr); PandaX-II full exposure 132 t d (0.36 t yr); ROI edges ~50 keV
XENONnT fiducial ~4.0 t, PandaX-4T fiducial ~2.7 t; 60% live fraction for future accrual
XENONnT continued data taking after SR1 (mid-2023) with long interruptions (neutron-veto Gd loading); untouched exposure 3.0 (2.0-5.0) t yr by Sep 2026
PandaX-4T resumed data taking in late 2023 after an upgrade; untouched exposure 2.5 (1.5-3.5) t yr by Sep 2026
XENONnT NR ROI upper edge ~60 keV (cS1 < 100 PE); PandaX-4T ~100 keV

recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (used only for the timeline drawing)

recalled_knowledge.item: Poisson-Gamma (negative binomial) predictive; Jeffreys prior gives Gamma(1.5, 1) after one count
Asimov significance Z = sqrt(2[(s+b) ln(1+s/b) - s]); PLR Z for observed n

failed_or_abandoned: First version defined the counting test on the whole LZ-like window (0.352/t yr) with only the 200-270 keV background, giving E_5sigma = 5.5 t yr; inconsistent (100-200 keV background 0.04/t yr) and replaced by a 200-270 keV band statistic
1-(1-p)^N_eff evaluated directly underflowed at p ~ 1e-15 (Z = 37 artefact); replaced by -expm1(N_eff*log1p(-p))
Zero-event UL90 for the end-2026 joint dataset first divided by 2.84 instead of the joint exposure; corrected
All-xenon '5 sigma year' initially read as a discovery date; relabelled as the date the required exposure existed on disk
